newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: MOTOR RACING-LAUDA LEAVES HOSPITAL AFTER KIDNEY TRANSPLANT.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-LAUDA LEAVES HOSPITAL AFTER KIDNEY TRANSPLANT.

text.p: Three-times Formula One world champion turned airline owner Niki Lauda was released on Tuesday from the Vienna AKH hospital where he underwent a kidney transplant last month.
Lauda, 48, who also acts as a consultant for his former Ferrari team, told a press conference he was not thinking of changing his lifestyle.
"I have always tried to lead a healthy life in order to keep my body fit," said Lauda, who quit motor racing in 1985 and founded an airline.
Lauda had suffered from a chronic kidney inflammation for some time before undergoing the transplant on April 24. His younger brother Florian was the donor.
Doctors had said the inflammation was not a consequence of Lauda's near-fatal accident at the German Grand Prix in 1976.
